subject: Project Orion — transfer of custody, rollout cadence and owners
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@atriahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@atriahealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12 -0800
Subject: Project Orion — transfer of custody, rollout cadence and owners

Hi team and Sofia,

Thanks again for the productive run-through this week. Quick executive summary so Customer Success has context for the hand-off and next 6 weeks of work. I pasted the short timeline, must-have acceptance criteria, and known risks below. The signed MSS and SOW are attached (Orion_SOW_v1.pdf) — DocuSign link in related links.

Deal at a glance
- Account: Atria Health (RDW-2026-ORION-58)
- Contract: 12-month, committed Dedicated capacity w/ 99.9% uptime SLA
- Committed go-live target: 2026-12-20 (pilot w/ two clinics)
- Primary contact: Sofia Morales (Sofia.Morales@atriahealth.com)

Proposed owners (please confirm):
- CS Lead (primary): Tessa Morgan — responsible for rollout plan, acceptance gates, weekly cadence
- Implementation Lead: Olga Petrov — staging, data ingestion, Okta SSO, model routing config
- Sales Exec / escalation: Ben Carter — commercial questions, PO and billing path

Key acceptance criteria (minimal):
1) Stable API latency at or below 180ms p50 under pilot load
2) End-to-end data flow for patient summary embeddings (test dataset attached)
3) SSO login for a pilot admin via Okta + role mapping
4) On-call playbook and rollback plan validated in staging

Immediate next steps (0–7 days):
- Procurement to finish PO and counter-signed SOW (procurement@atriahealth.com)
- Olga to provision staging cluster and share access (Orion-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx attached)
- Tessa to schedule kickoff with Atria for next Wed (preferred window 10am–1pm PST)

Risks / open questions:
- Atria requests longer log retention (90d) — need to confirm retention tier and potential cost delta
- Third-party feed (patient intake parser) may need mapping work; we have a sandbox but format variance unknown

Sofia — can you confirm the PO timeline and whether your security team needs additional evidence beyond the SOC2 report?

Thanks — tagging owners to confirm below.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@atriahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@atriahealth.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:14 -05:00
Subject: Re: Project Orion — transfer of custody, rollout cadence and owners

Hi Logan,

Appreciate the clear summary. A few quick items:
- Procurement: PO is in final review; expect to route to finance for signature by Friday 11/19.
- Security: SOC2 is fine; they also requested our standard DSP questionnaire and a network diagram. Can you send the diagram?
- Go-live: target window 12/20 is still OK, but we may need to push pilot start by a week if the data parser mapping takes longer. I'll confirm after procurement.

Also, can you confirm whether audit logs will include user IDs (pseudonymized) for compliance? If not, that will be a blocker.

Sofia
Sofia Morales
Sr. Director Product, Atria Health
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:37 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Orion custody split & sprint 0 checklist (owners please ack)

Internal only — do not forward.

Team, please see planned split and immediate owners. I want confirmations in-thread so Sofia and procurement retain visibility on the overall timeline but we keep operational chatter internal.

Owner matrix (single source of truth):
- Tessa: customer kickoff, weekly steering cadence, acceptance gate ownership, training plan
- Olga: staging provisioning, SSO (Okta) integration, ingestion mapping, KV cache tuning during pilot
- Ben: commercial closure, PO follow-up, billing/contract clarifications

Sprint 0 checklist (Days 0–14):
- Tessa: kick-off invite + agenda (include runbook walkthrough) — due Mon 11/15
- Olga: staging cluster + service accounts + Okta test app — due Tue 11/16
- Olga: share sample ingestion mapping doc and flag fields that need transformation — due Wed 11/17
- Tessa + Olga: run acceptance smoke test (api keys, basic inference, audit log check) — due Fri 11/19
- Ben: confirm PO ETA and share any billing constraints — ongoing

Known workarounds for risks:
- If parser mapping slips, propose a trimmed pilot that uses our CSV adapter and manual mapping for first 2 clinics
- For audit logs: we can enable pseudonymized user IDs and a retention tier of 90d on a short-term addon; Olga will scope cost impact

Please reply with short ack + any changes. If no objections by EOD Fri 11/13 we will present this to Atria in the kickoff invite.

— Logan
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@atriahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:04 -08:00
Subject: Re: Project Orion — transfer of custody, rollout cadence and owners

Acknowledged and taking lead.

Quick responses:
- I will send a proposed kickoff invite for Wed 11/17 at 10:30am PST (calendar hold to follow).
- I'll include a 45m agenda: introductions, success criteria, data ingestion sketch, SSO next steps, pilot scope and milestones, escalation path.
- I'll own the customer-facing runbook (deliver v0 by Mon 11/15) and will attach the runbook to the Drive folder in related links.

Olga — can you confirm access requirements for Atria's IAM team (public keys, SP metadata) so Tessa can add to the invite?

Sofia — noted on PO and audit logs. We will draft the pseudonymized ID approach and include estimated cost impact in the sprint 0 notes.

Thanks all — will loop in CS onboarding template and meeting link shortly.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
notes: Thread contains both customer-facing and internal coordination. Internal messages are clearly marked. Attachments referenced as stubs and DocuSign/Drive links provided.
